title: The Unsaid Interior
author: Isandro Delacroix
blurb: Isandro Underhill, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
